Subject: Vendor registration + PO field mapping / sample invoice for Royal Ridge Health

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for taking the time last week. Per our call, attaching the brief vendor registration PDF and a CSV invoice sample that matches how our AP system will generate invoices for Royal Ridge. Two quick asks so Finance can complete your vendor record and accept POs without delay: 

1) Confirm remit-to legal name and bank remit instructions (beneficial owner name + bank account last 4).
2) Please confirm your VAT/Tax ID exactly as it should appear on the invoice. For multi-entity customers we need the exact string to avoid PO matching failures.
3) Which PO fields are mandatory on your side? (we currently support: PO number, project code, department code, cost center — let me know if you require an extra 'billing contact' or GL code).

Notes on the sample CSV: we gave two rows (one invoice with two line items) and included the PO in the header row. If you prefer a single-line consolidated invoice we can generate that as well.

If your procurement portal (ProcureCloud) requires a supplier ID push, can you loop in accounts@procurecloud.com and cc me so we can coordinate the machine-to-machine mapping?

Attaching: RoyalRidge_vendor_form.pdf, invoice_sample_template.csv

Thanks — aiming to have you set up before your next payout cycle.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sales Operations (AP escalations)
Redwood Inference

- Remit-to name: Royal Ridge Health Services Ltd.
- Bank (last 4): 4321 (we'll upload full routing details via secure portal)
- VAT/Tax ID: RRH-VAT-334455 (please copy exactly)
- Mandatory PO fields: PO number, Department Code (3-digit), Cost Center (6-digit), and GL account (optional but preferred).

From: ProcureCloud Accounts <accounts@procurecloud.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO field mapping / sample invoice for Royal Ridge Health

Hi Sasha / Tessa —

Thanks for the vendor code. We support supplier pushes via SFTP and a simple POST to our supplier API. The invoice CSV sample you provided is mostly compatible; two small changes to avoid parsing errors on our side: 

- Header must include 'SupplierID' and 'InvoiceCurrency' columns.
- Use either ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the InvoiceDate column or Unix timestamp; mixed formats will cause rejects.

We can accept the supplier as RRH-3344 and will return a supplier GUID when the upload finishes. I copied the API spec: https://procurecloud.example.com/api/supplier-upload and attached a brief spec (procurecloud_supplier_spec.pdf).

If Redwood wants us to ping a webhook after supplier creation, include the callback URL in the POST and we will send the supplier GUID and status.

Regards,
Lina Guerrero
Supplier Ops — ProcureCloud
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@royalridgehealth.com>, ProcureCloud Accounts <accounts@procurecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration + PO field mapping / sample invoice for Royal Ridge Health

Great — thanks everyone. Quick internal notes / next steps: 

- Marissa: finance will accept RRH-VAT-334455 exactly as supplied; please create vendor record "Royal Ridge Health Services Ltd." with remit last-4 = 4321 and flag as "ProcureCloud: RRH-3344" in the external ID field. Attachments: PO_789201.pdf (sample PO), RoyalRidge_vendor_form.pdf.
- Karthik: on pricing/terms — Royal Ridge wants net-45. Confirm whether we can accept net-45 for this commercial pilot (they will onboard multiple projects).
- ProcureCloud: Tessa will POST the supplier CSV including SupplierID=RRH-3344, InvoiceCurrency=USD and callback URL: https://hooks.redwoodinference.com/procurecloud/vendor-sync. Please return the supplier GUID so Finance can reconcile.

Marissa — once vendor record done, can you confirm expected first payment date if invoice submitted by 6/4? Also confirm whether our invoice matching tolerances allow a +/- $0.01 variance (tax rounding) — Royal Ridge uses split VAT and sometimes triggers minor cents variance.

Sasha — I will re-export the CSV with the two additional columns and send to accounts@procurecloud.com this afternoon. If you have the split VAT spec please send it to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com.

Thanks — aiming to have the supplier live and accepting electronic invoices by next Monday so we can process the initial invoice in the June cycle.

—Tessa
